name: Harvester Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a boxy orange tree harvester whose long crane arm ends in Rotom's grinning head
entry: It can fell and mulch a tree in seconds. Keep one out of your garden, or it will happily chew through every tree it can reach.
how: Use a Harvester Engine on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Bug Buzz in this form.
